mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS menu_id, m.cat_id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, m.name, m.price, m.image_url, m.description, m.sold_out FROM menu m JOIN category c ON c.id = m.cat_id WHERE m.id = #{menuId}

SELECT ingredient_id AS ingredientId, ing_name AS name, ing_sold_out AS isSoldOut, role, quantity, unit, is_default AS isDefault, can_remove AS canRemove FROM vw_menu_ing_json WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY CASE UPPER(role) WHEN 'CORE' THEN 1 WHEN 'BASE' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, sort_no, ingredient_id

SELECT policy.option_group_id AS optionGroupId, policy.name, policy.is_required AS isRequired, ( SELECT recommended_item.item_name FROM JSON_TABLE( policy.items, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( item_name VARCHAR(120) PATH '$.name', is_recommended TINYINT PATH '$.isRecommended' ) ) AS recommended_item WHERE recommended_item.is_recommended = 1 LIMIT 1 ) AS recommendedLabel FROM vw_menu_opt_policy_json policy WHERE policy.menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY policy.sort_order
SELECT kcal, carb_g AS carbG, protein_g AS proteinG, fat_g AS fatG, sodium_mg AS sodiumMg FROM menu_nutr WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}

SELECT DISTINCT allergen_name FROM ( SELECT a.name AS allergen_name FROM menu_ing mi JOIN ing_allergen ia ON ia.ing_id = mi.ing_id JOIN allergen a ON a.id = ia.allergen_id WHERE mi.menu_id = #{menuId} UNION SELECT a.name AS allergen_name FROM menu_opt_policy mop JOIN opt_policy_item opi ON opi.policy_id = mop.policy_id JOIN opt_item oi ON oi.id = opi.opt_item_id JOIN ing_allergen ia ON ia.ing_id = oi.ing_id JOIN allergen a ON a.id = ia.allergen_id WHERE mop.menu_id = #{menuId} ) menu_allergens ORDER BY allergen_name
SELECT t.name FROM menu_tag mt JOIN tag t ON t.id = mt.tag_id WHERE mt.menu_id = #{menuId} AND t.active = 1 ORDER BY t.name
